title: Momoi Airi — Cooking Stream Prep〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Morning, you two!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Morning, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By the way, did you look at those documents we sent you the other day?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
I looked at everything you both sent me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I thought you did a good job of explaining how our fans would see things, Minori. Your suggestions should allow us to make the most of our strengths.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As for you, Shizuku, I really liked your idea of presenting some affordable skincare products. It feels like a good reason to keep this series going.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm glad you feel that way.
In that case, I'll start hammering out the details.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks. I jotted down some suggestions for ways we could make it even better, so let's keep doing what we can to turn these ideas into really good streams!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You made your own suggestions...?! Thank you so much, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Airi, how is your idea coming along? You've been helping us so much...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's coming along fine. I more or less know what I wanna do now, so I'm currently in the middle of working out the details. You two keep focusing on your own ideas.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
If you say so.
But let us know if you do need our help, okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I promise to let you know if that does happen.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's jump into today's agenda!
Evening
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I've taken a bath and finished stretching. Let's get back to working on my segment.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I told the other two that I'd be fine, so I need to make sure that we're able to put on a good stream...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... I was in the middle of choosing recipes for another cooking stream. My current candidates are...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Thankfully, this series has become pretty popular. It's nice how our viewers get to have fun regardless of whether or not they know how to cook.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (So, I'll want to cook something that they'll all like... Which should I choose?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Maybe something healthy with lots of veggies? Or a recipe that's both quick and easy...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's usually best to look to our fans about questions like these.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, let's see if I can find any clues in the comments. I'll take a look at our archived streams.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Last time, a lot of people said they really appreciated us going with a simple recipe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One person said, “My parents loved it when I made these for them.” And another even said, “I don't cook a lot, but this recipe ended up being really fun.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When you take our fans into consideration, it's probably best to go with a recipe that's geared towards novices instead of experienced cooks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, for our next stream...
The next day

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now then... We'll be giving our usual progress reports today, but I'd like to go first for a change!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Like I mentioned last time, I'm thinking about doing another cooking stream, and I've picked out some prospective recipes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, what are you gonna cook this time?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, this time, I'm going with... “An Easy Peasy & Appetizing Recipe!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: “An Easy Peasy & Appetizing Recipe”...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. After taking another look at our previous stream, I noticed that a lot of our viewers don't really cook on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, now that you mention it, you went with a simple recipe last time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which I believe led to a bunch of our viewers giving it a try themselves.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I'm thinking about doing something similar this time around.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hence the “easy peasy” recipe, yes?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If the recipes you chose really are both easy and appetizing, then I'm sure everyone will want to give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad you're saying that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also... While we're at it, I'd like to make sure it's nutritionally balanced.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A recipe that's both healthy and delicious.
With lots of veggies and other stuff that's good for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Once I've got my final list of candidates, I'll be doing a test run. When I do, I'll need you two to taste test for me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
I can't wait to try what you make, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You've been helping us quite a lot with our ideas, so we need to return the favor somehow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's all do our best.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm gonna need all the help you two can give me in order to make this stream a good one!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line:
Of course!
No problem!
